evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members, plus $7 million in separately paid fees and expenses subject to court approval.
Any fees the court does not award would go to the class.
We can offer a $30 million class fund plus $5 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval, with any fee reduction going to the class.

summary: Plaintiff first raised a specific fee amount in its initial public term sheet, before the class fund was finally agreed. The transcript also expressly links fee reductions to class recovery because unawarded fees would go to the class. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized its own fees over the class, that defense leveraged fee interests, or that the declaration was misleading.
